book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Ruuka

content: Ukuryʉka kwa Yɨɨsu
Ribhaga rya mʉmacha urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ rwi inyuma,
abhakari bhayo bhakaja kumbihɨra, bhabhanwirɨ amaguta ganʉ bhaakʉrirɨ.
Nawe riibhwɨ ikʉrʉ rɨnʉ ryarɨ riribhirɨ imbihɨra, bhakarebhona rihiringitiibhwɨ rusizʉ.
Neho bhakasikɨra mʉʉsi, bhakabhona ɨkɨtʉndʉ chʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu kɨtariimu.
Hanʉ bhaarɨ bhakɨɨrɨ bhararʉgʉʉra igʉrʉ wɨ ɨngʼana yiyo, hayohayo rusizʉ waabhʉ, bhakiimɨɨrɨra abhasubhɨ bhabhɨrɨ, bhiibhʉhirɨ zengebho zɨnzɨrʉ za pee!
Abhakari bhayo bhakabharora bhakagwatwa nu ubhwʉbha bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakiihiinya kuhika haasɨ. Neho abhasubhɨ bhayo bhakabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ndora mʉramohya ʉmʉhʉru mʉbhaku?
Atarɨ hanʉ! Aryukirɨ! Muhiitɨ amangʼana ganʉ aabhabhuuriirɨ hanʉ aarɨ akɨɨrɨ Gariraaya.
Akabhuga, ‘Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ, areenderwa ahurukibhwɨ mʉmabhoko ga bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, na bharamʉbhamba kʉmʉsarabha nu urusikʉ rwa katatʉ araryʉka.’ ”
Abhakari bhayo bhakahiita amangʼana ga Yɨɨsu,
bhakahʉrʉka mumbihɨra, bhakaja kʉbhʉʉrɨra abhatumwa bha Yɨɨsu ikumi na wʉmwɨ, hamwɨmwɨ na abhandɨ bhʉʉsi.
Abhakari bhayo, nɨ‑Mariyamu wa Magidarena, Yowana, Mariyamu unina Yaakobho, hamwɨmwɨ na abhakari abhandɨ bhanʉ bhaarɨ hamwɨmwɨ neebho.
Nawe, bhakabhʉʉrɨra abhatumwa bha Yɨɨsu, bhakagarora kina gataana bhwera, bhatagiisiriiryɨ.
Peetero akiimɨɨrɨra rogendo rʉmwɨ, akaryara mwega kuja kumbihɨra. Hanʉ aahikirɨ, akiihiinya na kwisʉnza mumbihɨra, akarora ɨsanda. Akarwa hayo, ariibhuurya bhʉkʉngʼu ganʉ arʉʉzɨ.
Yɨɨsu arabhahwarʉkɨra abhɨɨga bhabhɨrɨ
Urusikʉ ruyoruyo, bhabhɨrɨ bha abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu bhakabha morogendo kuja ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Ɨmau. Ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo, rwarɨ kina matambʉka bhɨkwɨ ikumi na kɨmwɨ kurwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
Bhabhɨrɨ bhayo bhakaja bharagamba igʉrʉ wa amangʼana ganʉ gakʉrirwɨ.
Na hanʉ bhaarɨ bhakɨɨrɨ bharagamba, Yɨɨsu akaaza, akagenda hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ.
Nawe bhakabha bharibhirwɨ amɨɨsʉ gaabhʉ, bhataamʉmɨnyirɨ.
Akabhabhuurya, “Mʉragambakɨ ɨnʉ mʉragenda?” Bhakiimɨɨrɨra, ubhushʉ bhwabhʉ bharingirɨ ekomo.
Wʉmwɨ waabhʉ, iriina ryazɨ Kireopa, akamʉgarukirya, “Mʉbhagini bhʉʉsi bha Yɨrusarɨɨmu, naawɨ aumwene ʉkɨɨrɨ kwigwa ganʉ gakʉrirwɨ zisikʉ zɨnʉ?”

Akabhabhuurya, “Mangʼanakɨ gayo?” Bhakamʉgarukirya, “Itwɨ tʉragamba igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu wa Nazarɨɨti. Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi na Mungu, bhakarora kʉbha aarɨ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri, amangʼana na amahocha gaazɨ gaarɨ na zinguru bhʉkʉngʼu.
Nawe abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani na abhiimiiririri bhɨɨtʉ bhamuhurukiryɨ atinirwɨ kukwa, bhakamʉbhamba kʉmʉsarabha.
Na newe twisɨgirɨ kʉbha aratuurya Abhiiziraɨri. Kwɨma gayo gʉʉsi gakʉrirwɨ, reero ni‑rusikʉ rwa katatʉ.
“Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, abhamwɨ bha abhakari gatɨ wɨɨtʉ bhatʉtachiryɨ. Reero mʉmacha bhakaja mumbiihɨra,
bhakabhona ɨkɨtʉndʉ cha Yɨɨsu kɨtariimu. Bhakagarʉka na kʉtʉbhʉʉrɨra kʉbha, bhakarora ʉbhʉrʉri bhwa maraika, bhanʉ bhaabhugirɨ Yɨɨsu nɨ‑mʉhʉru.
Akʉmara, abhandɨ bhanʉ bhaarɨ na niitwɨ bhakaja kumbihɨra, bhakabhona gʉʉsi chɨmbu abhakari bhayo bhaatubhuuriirɨ, bhʉʉsi bhatarʉʉzɨ ɨkɨtʉndʉ.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ndora imwɨ bhageegebhu, Kwakɨ bhakʉngʼu mʉrɨ kwisirirya amangʼana ganʉ abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhaagambirɨ?
Nangʉ Kiriisitʉ atɨɨndirwɨ kʉhɨtɨra ɨnyaakʉ yiyo, na kusikɨra mʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwazɨ.”
Neho Yɨɨsu akabheerekeererya amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ gaandikirwɨ igʉrʉ waazɨ kwɨma mʉbhɨtabhʉ bhya Musa, kuhika ɨbhɨtabhʉ bhyʉsi bhya abharʉʉtɨrɨri.
Hanʉ bhiisukirɨ ʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ bhaarɨ bhakuja, Yɨɨsu akabha nkina arangʼeha no rogendo.
Nawe, bhakamwisasaama bhʉkʉngʼu, “Wiikarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niitwɨ hanʉ, kʉ kʉbha nangwɨnʉ igoroobha ni ikiirimya kisikiirɨ.” Neho Yɨɨsu akasikɨra munyumba bhakiikara hamwɨmwɨ.
Bhakiikara kubhyakurya, Yɨɨsu akagega ʉmʉkaatɨ akagʉsabhɨra, akagusunyura, akabhasondya.
Hayohayo, bhakaramuchwa amɨɨsʉ gaabhʉ, bhakamenya kʉbha nɨ‑Yɨɨsu. Wʉʉsi rogendo rʉmwɨ akabhʉra.
Bhakiibhuurya, “Awɨɨ! Hanʉ aarɨ akʉgamba na niitwɨ kʉnzɨra na kʉtʉbhʉʉrɨra igʉrʉ wa Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, nangʉ tutiigwirɨ nkina omorero gʉraaka mozekoro zɨɨtʉ?”
Ribhaga riyoriyo bhakabhʉʉka, bhakagarʉka Yɨrusarɨɨmu. Bhakarumana na abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu ikumi na wʉmwɨ bhiibhiringirɨ hamwɨmwɨ na abhakɨndichabhʉ.
Hanʉ bhabhɨrɨ bhayo bhaahikirɨ, abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu bhakabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨ‑maheene kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ aryukirɨ, na ahwarukiirɨ Simʉʉni!”
Neho bhakabhʉʉrɨra abhakɨndichabhʉ gʉʉsi ganʉ gakʉrirwɨ mʉnzɨra. Bhakabhabhʉʉrɨra na chɨmbu bhaamɨnyirɨ Yɨɨsu, hanʉ aabhasunyuriirɨ ʉmʉkaatɨ.
Yɨɨsu arahwarʉkɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ
Hanʉ abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu bhaarɨ bhachagamba igʉrʉ wa gayo, rogendo rʉmwɨ Yɨɨsu akiimɨɨrɨra gatɨ waabhʉ, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Omorembe gʉbhɨ na niimwɨ.”
Bhakiitacha, bhakʉʉbhaha bhʉkʉngʼu kʉ kʉbha bhakakina bhararora ɨkɨhwɨ.
Nawe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Kwakɨ zekoro zaanyu ziitiimaatirɨ? Mʉna amakɨbhwɨ bhʉkʉngʼu mozekoro zaanyu?
Morore amabhoko na amagʉrʉ gaanɨ, kʉbha niinyɨ. Mʉmbatɨbhatɨ morore! Ɨkɨhwɨ kɨtaana mʉbhɨrɨ na amaguha, chɨmbu mokorora inyɨ nɨnago.”
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra gayo, akabheerecha amabhoko na amagʉrʉ gaazɨ.
Abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, bhakazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu kuhika bhatiisiriiryɨ arɨɨbhɨ gʉʉsi nɨ‑maheene. Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Hanʉ kʉna bhyakurya bhyʉbhyʉsi?”
Bhakamoha ritɨnɨka ryi iiswɨ ɨnyʉchu,
akagega, akarya embere waabhʉ.

Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Garya nabhabhuuriirɨ ribhaga nɨkɨɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ, kʉbha gʉʉsi gaandikirwɨ igʉrʉ waanɨ mumigirʉ ja Musa, mʉbhɨtabhʉ bhya abharʉʉtɨrɨri, na mʉbhɨtabhʉ bhya Zabhuri gareenderwa kokorwa.”
Neho Yɨɨsu akabharimʉʉrʉra amangʼɨɨni gaabhʉ bhamenye Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu.
Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨmbu yandikirwɨ, Kiriisitʉ aranyaakibhwa, nu urusikʉ rwa katatʉ, araryʉka kurwa mʉbhaku.
Abhaatʉ bha mubhyarʉ bhyʉsi, kwɨma Yɨrusarɨɨmu hanʉ, bharwazirwɨ kuriina ryazɨ bhatigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ, korereke bhabheererwe.
Amangʼana gayo gamarirɨ kokorwa, na niimwɨ nɨ‑bhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bha gayo.
“Mwangarɨrɨ! Nɨrabhareetera Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, chɨmbu Bhaabha aamarirɨ kʉbharaga. Nawe, mʉrɨndɨ mʉrʉbhɨri hanʉ, kuhika Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨraazɨ, mʉrahaabhwa ʉbhʉnaja kurwa mwisaarʉ.”
Yɨɨsu aragegwa kuja mwisaarʉ
Akʉmara Yɨɨsu akabhahira abhɨɨga bhaazɨ haguhɨ nʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Bhɨtaniya, bhakahika harya, akanʉnga amabhoko gaazɨ igʉrʉ, akabhaha ʉrʉbhangʉ.
Akɨɨrɨ arabhaha ʉrʉbhangʉ, akabhatiga, akagegwa kuja mwisaarʉ.
Bhakamosengera, akʉmara bhakagarʉka Yɨrusarɨɨmu, bhazʉmɨɨrwɨ bhʉkʉngʼu.
Bhakiikara mwihekaaru, bharakumya Mungu.
